arXiv:2609.09009v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 9 月 8 日arXiv:2609.09009v1 [cs.LG] 08 Sep 2026

放手或学会自我纠正：Let It Go or Learn to Self-Correct:
受限离散任务的连续扩散Continuous Diffusion for Constrained Discrete Tasks

Mariia Drozdova Affiliation: University of Geneva Email: mariia.drozdova@unige.ch    Stéphane Liem Nguyen Affiliation: University of Geneva Email: stephane.nguyen@unige.ch    François Fleuret Affiliation: University of Geneva Email: francois.fleuret@unige.ch
摘要Abstract

去噪扩散概率模型 (DDPM) 通过从噪声开始并重复去噪来生成样本，同时保持每次更新接近当前的噪声状态。这种行为在许多连续领域中是有效的，但对于全局约束的离散任务（例如数独， 图连通性、拉丁方和 N 皇后。在这种情况下，早期的离散错误可能很难消除。因此，即使模型的清晰预测信息丰富，标准扩散抽样也可能保留早期错误。我们将标准采样器与直接从模型的干净预测中采样进行比较。无需重新训练，这一单一更改即可将数独有效性从Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) generate samples by starting from noise and repeatedly denoising while keeping each update close to the current noisy state. This behavior is effective in many continuous domains, but its role is less clear for globally constrained discrete tasks, such as Sudoku, graph connectivity, Latin squares, and N-queens. In such settings, early discrete errors can be difficult to undo. As a result, standard diffusion sampling may preserve early mistakes, even when the model’s clean predictions are informative. We compare standard samplers to sampling directly from the model’s clean prediction. Without retraining, this single change improves Sudoku validity from31%31\% to 95%95\%，在其他离散任务中具有一致的增益。我们假设保持接近当前噪声状态是有害的，因为反向轨迹可能会偏离模型所训练的前向噪声分布。为了减少这种训练与测试的不匹配，我们进一步引入了自我校正训练，使模型能够接受自己的预测，从而提高对推理过程中出现的错误的鲁棒性。这大大提高了标准采样器的性能。我们的结果表明，连续扩散模型可以学习重要的全局约束，但离散推理任务需要训练和推理之间更好的一致性：要么通过减少对早期决策的承诺的采样器，要么通过训练模型纠正其自身的推理时间错误。, with consistent gains across the other discrete tasks. We hypothesize that staying close to the current noisy state is harmful because the reverse trajectory can drift off the forward noising distribution the model was trained on. To reduce this train-test mismatch, we further introduce self-correction training, which exposes the model to its own predictions, improving robustness to errors that arise during inference. This substantially improves the performance of standard samplers. Our results suggest that continuous diffusion models can learn nontrivial global constraints, but discrete reasoning tasks require better alignment between training and inference: either through samplers that reduce commitment to early decisions, or through training that teaches the model to correct its own inference-time errors.

1 简介Introduction

扩散模型已成为连续领域生成建模的主导范例，在图像等高维感知数据上实现了最先进的性能Diffusion models have become a dominant paradigm for generative modeling in continuous domains, achieving state-of-the-art performance on high-dimensional perceptual data such as imagesHo et al. (2020); Karras et al. (2022); Song et al. (2020); Song et al. (2021); Rombach et al. (2022)和视频and videosAlonso et al. (2024); Ho et al. (2022); Xing et al. (2024)。鉴于这一成功，值得一问的是它们是否也可以处理全局约束的离散任务。先前的工作已通过明确的机制将约束纳入扩散模型：投影. Given this success, it is worth asking whether they can also handle globally constrained discrete tasks. Prior work has incorporated constraints into diffusion models through explicit mechanisms: projectionChristopher et al. (2024); Utkarsh et al. (2025), 指导, guidanceInoue et al. (2023)，或基于搜索的后处理, or search-based post-processingSun and Yang (2023)。基于 D3PM 的离散扩散方法. Discrete diffusion methods built on D3PMAustin et al. (2021)已应用于组合优化have been applied to combinatorial optimizationSun and Yang (2023)、解谜和可满足性, puzzle solving and satisfiabilityYe et al. (2024)，以及受控的文本和分子生成, and controlled text and molecule generationCardei et al. (2025)。 关于组合问题，DIFUSCO. On combinatorial problems, DIFUSCOSun and Yang (2023)评估基于 D3PM 的离散扩散和连续扩散evaluated both D3PM-based discrete diffusion and continuous diffusionChen et al. (2022)，报告后者效果较差。在这项工作中，我们研究了为什么标准连续扩散采样可能无法完成这些任务，以及采样和训练的改变是否可以减轻这些失败。, reporting the latter as less effective. In this work, we investigate why standard continuous diffusion sampling can fail on these tasks and whether changes to sampling and training can mitigate these failures.

我们研究受约束的离散任务，其中约束隐含在数据中，而不是显式提供给模型：数独We study constrained discrete tasks where constraints are implicit in the data rather than provided explicitly to the model: SudokuJolicoeur-Martineau (2025); Wang et al. (2025); Wewer et al. (2025), 图连通性, graph connectivityDu et al. (2024)、拉丁方和 N 皇后。这些基准与最近的迭代推理方法密切相关：HRM/TRM 使用递归细化, Latin squares, and N-queens. These benchmarks are closely related to recent iterative-reasoning approaches: HRM/TRM use recursive refinementWang et al. (2025); Jolicoeur-Martineau (2025)，SRM研究基于去噪的空间推理和采样顺序选择, SRM studies denoising-based spatial reasoning and sampling-order choicesWewer et al. (2025)，IRED 将图连通性视为迭代能量扩散, and IRED casts graph connectivity as iterative energy diffusionDu et al. (2024)。我们的目标是互补的：我们使用这些任务来诊断标准连续扩散本身，询问降噪器何时学习有用的全局结构，为什么推理无法产生有效样本，以及如何改进。. Our goal is complementary: we use these tasks to diagnose standard continuous diffusion itself, asking when the denoiser learns useful global structure, why inference can fail to produce valid samples, and how it can be improved.

在 DDPM 中In DDPMsHo et al. (2020)，每个反向步骤都会根据当前状态进行一个小的更新，这非常适合感知数据，但其对全局约束的离散任务的影响不太清楚。在受限离散任务中，我们观察到标准 DDPM 的故障模式 采样：生成的样本在局部看起来似乎合理（例如，每个单元格类似于一个有效符号：one-hot 编码或有效的 MNIST 图像），但在全局上仍然无效（例如，不满足数独约束）。这就提出了一个问题：降噪器是否无法学习约束，或者反向更新是否无法有效地使用降噪器的干净预测？, each reverse step makes a small update conditioned on the current state, which is well suited to perceptual data but its effect on globally constrained discrete tasks is less clear. In constrained discrete tasks, we observe a failure mode of standard DDPM sampling: generated samples can look locally plausible (e.g. each cell resembles a valid symbol: one-hot encoding or valid MNIST image) but remain globally invalid (e.g. Sudoku constraints are not satisfied). This raises a question: does the denoiser fail to learn the constraints, or does the reverse update fail to use the denoiser’s clean prediction effectively?

我们首先通过仅修改反向更新来测试这一点。 DDPM 和修改后的采样器都使用当前状态We first test this by modifying only the reverse update. Both DDPM and the modified sampler use the current statextx_{t}作为降噪器的输入，产生一个干净的建议as input to the denoiser, producing a clean proposalx^0​(xt,t)\hat{x}_{0}(x_{t},t)。不同之处在于该提案形成后发生的情况：DDPM 具有直接. The difference is what happens after this proposal is formed: DDPM carries a directxtx_{t}依赖残差进入反向均值，保持下一个状态与当前模拟状态相关。我们删除了这个直接残差，产生了广义 DDIM/DDPM 采样族的极限情况-dependent residual into the reverse mean, keeping the next state tied to the current analog state. We remove this direct residual, yielding a limiting case of the generalized DDIM/DDPM sampling familySong et al. (2020)我们称之为 Tweedie 重投影。这种仅推理的更改在相同的检查点上带来了巨大的收益，从而提高了单热数独的有效性that we call Tweedie reprojection. This inference-only change gives large gains on the same checkpoints, improving one-hot Sudoku validity from31%31\% to 95%95\%。因此，降噪器已经学习了有用的约束结构，但一旦轨迹开始漂移，并不总是足够鲁棒地引导 DDPM 轨迹。. Thus, the denoiser has learned useful constraint structure, but not always robustly enough to guide the DDPM trajectory once that trajectory begins to drift.

我们将其解释为训练-推理不匹配的一种形式We interpret this as a form of training-inference mismatchNing et al. (2023); Ning et al. (2024); Deng et al. (2023); Ren et al. (2024); Zhang et al. (2025); Li and van der Schaar (2024)。在训练期间，模型会看到前向噪声 有效样品。然而，在采样期间，相反的过程是由 模型自身的不完美预测。小的去噪误差可能会导致 走向局部合理但全局无效的状态的轨迹；然后，DDPM 残差可以使后续更新接近这些状态，从而导致错误复合。这促使我们还通过自我校正损失来修改训练过程，其中模型暴露于噪声版本 自己的中间预测并训练以恢复原始有效 目标。这种训练修改改进了标准采样器：例如， DDPM 对单热数独的有效性从. During training, the model sees forward-noised valid samples. During sampling, however, the reverse process is driven by the model’s own imperfect predictions. Small denoising errors can move the trajectory toward states that are locally plausible but globally invalid; the DDPM residual can then keep subsequent updates close to these states, causing errors to compound. This motivates us to also modify the training process with self-correction loss, where the model is exposed to noised versions of its own intermediate predictions and trained to recover the original valid target. This training modification improves standard samplers: for example, DDPM’s validity on one-hot Sudoku rises from31%31\% to 87%87\%.

我们的研究重点是受控约束离散基准。 Tweedie 重投影应被视为解码约束满足的诊断，而不是一般采样器：在感知丰富的领域中，Our study focuses on controlled constrained-discrete benchmarks. Tweedie reprojection should be viewed as a diagnostic for decoded constraint satisfaction, not as a general sampler: in perceptually rich domains, thextx_{t}残余物可能携带重要的细节，丢弃它可能会损害发电质量。自我修正只能部分解决训练与推理不匹配的问题；更完整的方法仍有待未来的工作。residual may carry important detail and discarding it may harm generation quality. Self-correction only partially addresses the training-inference mismatch; more complete approaches remain future work.

总之，我们的贡献是：In summary, our contributions are:

  • •

    我们确定了受约束离散推理任务的连续扩散的失败模式，其中推理可能导致局部合理但全局不一致的状态。We identify a failure mode of continuous diffusion on constrained discrete reasoning tasks, where inference can lead to locally plausible but globally inconsistent states.

  • •

    我们研究直接的作用We study the role of the directxtx_{t}DDPM 采样中的残差相关，并表明去除该残差可以在无需重新训练的情况下显着提高约束满足度。-dependent residual in DDPM sampling, and show that removing this residual can substantially improve constraint satisfaction without retraining.

  • •

    我们提出了一种自我校正训练程序，将降噪器暴露于其自身预测的噪声版本中。这减少了训练-推理不匹配并改进了标准采样器（Euler、Euler-Maruyama、DDPM）。We propose a self-correction training procedure exposing the denoiser to noisy versions of its own predictions. This reduces the training-inference mismatch and improves standard samplers (Euler, Euler-Maruyama, DDPM).11 1代码将在以下位置提供：Code will be available athttps://github.com/MariiaDrozdova/continuous_diffusion_for_constrained_tasks

(2021)对应于corresponds toσ(t)2=−2α˙(t)/α(t)\sigma(t)^{2}=-2\dot{\alpha}(t)/\alpha(t)。在实践中，学习降噪器和有限步求解器会引入模型和离散化误差，因此不同的选择. In practice, learned denoisers and finite-step solvers introduce model and discretization error, so different choices ofσ⁡(t)\sigma(t)可能导致不同的经验表现。因此我们对待can lead to different empirical performance. We therefore treatσ⁡(t)\sigma(t)作为基于 Euler-Maruyama 的采样器的采样器超参数。as a sampler hyperparameter for Euler-Maruyama-based samplers.

3 方法Method

3.1 Inference under constraint violations

Under the denoising objective (4），模型仅暴露于噪声版本), the model is only exposed to noisy versionsxtx_{t}有效样本数of valid samplesx0x_{0}。学习到的降噪器. The learned denoiserfθ​(xt,t)f_{\theta}(x_{t},t)然后用作表单反向更新中干净对象的插件估计is then used as a plug-in estimate of the clean object in reverse updates of the formq⁡(xt−1∣xt,x^0)q(x_{{t-1}}\mid x_{t},\hat{x}_{0})。然而，在受限任务的推理时，不完美的分数估计可能会将采样轨迹推向中间状态，而这在任何有效解决方案的前向噪声轨迹下都是不可能的。. However, at inference time on constrained tasks, imperfect score estimates can drive the sampling trajectory toward intermediate states that are unlikely under the forward noising trajectory of any valid solution.

这会导致训练中遇到的状态与推理过程中访问的状态之间不匹配（暴露偏差）This creates a mismatch between the states encountered in training and those visited during inference (exposure bias)Ning et al. (2023); Ning et al. (2024); Deng et al. (2023); Ren et al. (2024); Zhang et al. (2025); Li and van der Schaar (2024)。在这种情况下，标准 DDPM 反向更新. In this regime, the standard DDPM reverse updateq⁡(xt−1∣xt,x^0)q(x_{{t-1}}\mid x_{t},\hat{x}_{0})可以保存信息 当前状态，即使该状态包含错误的离散承诺， leading to global constraint violations.我们从两个方面解决这种不匹配问题 方向：（i）减少对电流的直接依赖的采样规则 形成干净提案后的状态can preserve information from the current state even when that state contains wrong discrete commitments, leading to global constraint violations. We address this mismatch from two directions: (i) a sampling rule that reduces direct dependence on the current state after forming the clean proposalx^0\hat{x}_{0}（第二节(Sec.3.2），以及（ii）暴露的培训目标 模型自己的预测，提高了遇到的状态的鲁棒性 采样期间（秒）), and (ii) a training objective that exposes the model to its own predictions, improving robustness to the states encountered during sampling (Sec.3.3).

The D3PM rows use separately trained discrete-diffusion models and are included as an external reference. We first consider the baseline models, trained without self-correction. The standard samplers, DDPM and EM, give broadly similar performance across tasks, with DDPM requiring no sampler hyperparameter tuning and EM using the noise level chosen according to the protocol described above. We then compare against two ways of changing the stochastic reverse process: EM decay, which allows larger noise early in sampling and anneals it toward the data endpoint, and Tweedie reprojection, which changes the reverse-step center by removing thextx_{t}残留。这两种修改都比基线下的标准采样器有所改进，而 Tweedie 重投影提供了最大且最一致的增益。例如，在 21 条线索数独中，成功率提高了约residual. Both modifications improve over the standard samplers under baseline, while Tweedie reprojection gives the largest and most consistent gains. For example, on 21-clue Sudoku, success improves from about31%31\%与 DDPM 至with DDPM to95%95\%与 Tweedie 重投影。其他数据集也出现了类似的改进。这表明，对于单热编码的约束离散任务，使用标准去噪目标训练的模型已经可以做出有用的干净预测。with Tweedie reprojection. Similar improvements appear across other datasets. This suggests that, for one-hot encoded constrained discrete tasks, a model trained with the standard denoising objective can already make useful clean predictions.

This suggests that self-correction partially fixes the reverse-process failure by training the model on sampler-induced states rather than only on forward-noised valid samples. Finally, combining self-correction with the modified samplers gives the strongest overall results: Tweedie reprojection and EM decay are both highly competitive, with each being best or tied for best on different tasks. Overall, the table supports two conclusions: removing thextx_{t}对于表示为 one-hot 向量的受限离散任务，残差在推理时已经非常有益，并且自校正通过训练模型从采样期间遇到的错误中恢复来进一步提高鲁棒性。residual is already highly beneficial at inference time for constrained discrete tasks represented as one-hot vectors, and self-correction further improves robustness by training the model to recover from errors encountered during sampling.

5 分析Analysis

局部合理但全局无效的状态。Locally plausible but globally invalid states.

上面的结果表明，相同的降噪器在不同的采样器下表现可能非常不同。问题不在于模型永远不会学习有效的局部符号。最终的连续输出可以接近单热表示，而无需其解码的网格有效（表The results above show that the same denoiser can behave very differently under different samplers. The issue is not that the model never learns valid local symbols. The final continuous output can be close to a one-hot representation without its decoded grid being valid (Table12）。类似地，在 MNIST-Sudoku 中，单个单元可能类似于可识别的数字，而整个棋盘违反了数独约束。). Similarly, in MNIST-Sudoku, individual cells can resemble recognizable digits while the full board violates Sudoku constraints.

这会造成特定的训练-推理不匹配。对前向噪声有效对象进行标准去噪训练，This creates a specific training-inference mismatch. Standard denoising trains on forward-noised valid objects,xt=α⁡(t)​x0+β⁡(t)​ϵ,x0∈𝒱.x_{t}=\alpha(t)x_{0}+\beta(t)\epsilon,x_{0}\in\mathcal{V}.在推理过程中，模型可以访问其自身不完美提案的嘈杂版本。这些状态可能在局部是合理的，但在全局是无效的。尽管高斯噪声具有完全支持，但采样器产生的结构化无效状态在普通前向噪声下可能接收很少的训练量。因此，降噪器并未经过直接训练来精确校正逆过程可能产生的状态。During inference, the model can instead visit noisy versions of its own imperfect proposals. These states may be locally plausible and globally invalid. Although Gaussian noise has full support, the structured invalid states produced by the sampler might receive little training mass under ordinary forward noising. The denoiser is therefore not directly trained to correct precisely the states that the reverse process may create.

DDPM 可以保留全局无效的解码状态。DDPM can preserve globally invalid decoded states.

方程（Equation (7）表明 DDPM 反向中心包含一个) shows that the DDPM reverse center contains anxtx_{t}除了降噪器的干净预测之外，还依赖于残差。这种残差本质上并不是有害的：它使反向更新保持接近当前的模拟状态，当当前状态位于可靠的轨迹上并且包含应该持续的细节时，这是合适的。我们的设置中的问题是-dependent residual in addition to the denoiser’s clean prediction. This residual is not intrinsically harmful: it keeps the reverse update close to the current analog state, which is appropriate when the current state lies on a reliable trajectory and contains details that should persist. The problem in our setting is thatxtx_{t}已经可以对违反离散约束的小错误进行编码，并且降噪器不一定经过训练来纠正这种采样器引起的状态。然后，残差可以使更新保持在本地合理但全局无效的解码配置附近。can already encode small mistakes that violate discrete constraints, and the denoiser has not necessarily been trained to correct such sampler-induced states. The residual can then keep the update near a locally plausible but globally invalid decoded configuration.

We writeEbothE_{\mathrm{both}}对于两个中心同时解码为有效配置的事件，for the event that both centers decode to valid configurations at the same reverse time,E+E_{+}对于只有 Tweedie 中心有效的事件，并且for the event that only the Tweedie center is valid, andE−E_{-}对于只有DDPM中心有效的事件。因此残留物对for the event that only the DDPM center is valid. Thus the residual is harmless onEbothE_{\mathrm{both}}, 有帮助, helpful onE−E_{-}，并且有害于, and harmful onE+E_{+}。跨越轨迹，. Across trajectories,E+E_{+}远大于is much larger thanE−E_{-}。在这种情况下，DDPM 残差更经常地将有效的干净提案转变为无效的中心更新，而不是拯救无效的提案。 Tweedie 重投影受到提案质量的限制：它可以利用信息丰富的干净提案，但当降噪器的提案仍然很差时无法进行补偿。然而，提案质量并不是失败的唯一原因：在 Sudoku-Extreme 上，有效提案至少出现一次. In this regime, the DDPM residual more often turns a valid clean proposal into an invalid centered update than it rescues an invalid proposal. Tweedie reprojection is limited by proposal quality: it can exploit an informative clean proposal, but cannot compensate when the denoiser’s proposals remain poor. Proposal quality is not the only source of failure, however: on Sudoku-Extreme, a valid proposal appeared at least once in62%62\%失败的 Tweedie 轨迹，但最终样本仍然无效（见附录of failed Tweedie trajectories, but the final sample was still invalid (see AppendixP).

自我纠正针对的是缺失的训练状态。Self-correction targets the missing training states.

同样的机制建议在训练方面进行修复。自校正不像标准扩散那样仅将模型暴露于噪声有效对象，而是将模型暴露于其自身中间预测的噪声版本，同时保持原始有效对象作为目标。因此，模型经过训练，可以将模型引发的、可能无效的状态映射回有效的解决方案。图The same mechanism suggests a training-side fix. Instead of exposing the model only to noisy valid objects as standard diffusion does, self-correction also exposes the model to noisy versions of its own intermediate predictions while keeping the original valid object as the target. Thus the model is trained to map model-induced, possibly invalid states back to a valid solution. Figure22(b)显示出这样的效果。沿着 DDPM 轨迹，基线降噪器提出有效网格的频率比沿着 Tweedie 轨迹的频率要低得多。自我修正大大提高了 DDPM 引起的状态下提案的有效性。这解释了为什么自校正缩小了 DDPM-Tweedie 差距：它不会删除 DDPM 锚点，但它使降噪器在推理过程中遇到的状态更加可靠，同时也改善了轨迹。shows this effect. Along DDPM trajectories, the baseline denoiser proposes valid grids much less often than along Tweedie trajectories. Self-correction substantially improves proposal validity on DDPM-induced states. This explains why self-correction narrows the DDPM-Tweedie gap: it does not remove the DDPM anchor, but it makes the denoiser more reliable on the states encountered during inference, improving the trajectory as well.

额外的消融支持了这种解释（见附录Additional ablations support this interpretation (see AppendixL）。输入扰动). Input perturbationNing et al. (2023)和自我调节and self-conditioningChen et al. (2022)弱于自我校正，这表明重要的因素不是对额外噪声或额外记忆通道的通用鲁棒性，而是暴露于模型引起的状态。随机符号损坏（参见附录are weaker than self-correction, suggesting that the important ingredient is not generic robustness to extra noise or an additional memory channel, but exposure to model-induced states. Random symbol corruptions (see AppendixL.2）也有助于 DDPM，但仍然弱于自校正，这表明任意无效网格与推理采样分布的匹配程度不如模型自身的中间预测。) also help DDPM, but remain weaker than self-correction, indicating that arbitrary invalid grids are less well matched to the inference sampling distribution than the model’s own intermediate predictions.

采样器间隙不仅仅是噪声尺度效应。The sampler gap is not only a noise-scale effect.

在采样方面，EM 衰减表明额外的随机性也有帮助：它在采样早期注入更多噪声，并在数据端点附近退火该噪声。这可能会破坏一些不良的中间承诺，同时仍允许样本在接近尾声时稳定下来。不过，附录图On the sampling side, EM decay shows that additional stochasticity can also help: it injects more noise early in sampling and anneals this noise near the data endpoint. This can break some bad intermediate commitments while still allowing the sample to settle near the end. However, Appendix Figure11表明仅改变采样方差并不能缩小 DDPM-Tweedie 差距。缩放 DDPM 噪声会改变内核采样的范围，但不会改变其中心位置。相反，Tweedie 重投影通过围绕干净提案进行采样来改变中心，而不是继续相同的依赖于状态的更新。shows that changing the sampling variance alone does not close the DDPM-Tweedie gap. Scaling the DDPM noise changes how broadly the kernel samples, but not where it is centered. Tweedie reprojection instead changes the center by sampling around the clean proposal rather than continuing the same state-dependent update.

训练-推理不匹配和暴露偏差。Training-inference mismatch and exposure bias.

先前的工作已将训练-推理不匹配（暴露偏差）确定为序列模型中误差积累的来源Prior work has identified training-inference mismatch (exposure bias) as a source of error accumulation in sequential modelsBengio et al. (2015); Ross et al. (2011); Huang et al. (2025); Bachmann and Nagarajan (2024); Chen et al. (2024); Du et al. (2024)。 在扩散模型中，会出现类似的效果，因为模型是在噪声真实样本上进行训练的，但在推理时接收到自己的预测作为输入. In diffusion models, similar effects arise because the model is trained on noisy ground-truth samples but receives its own predictions as inputs at inference timeNing et al. (2023); Ning et al. (2024); Deng et al. (2023); Ren et al. (2024); Zhang et al. (2025); Li and van der Schaar (2024)，并且在温和的假设下，误差已被证明必然沿着不完美扩散模型的采样轨迹累积, and error has been shown to necessarily accumulate along the sampling trajectory of imperfect diffusion models under mild assumptionsLi and van der Schaar (2024)。 最近的方法通过修改训练过程来减轻暴露偏差：扰动输入. Recent approaches mitigate exposure bias by modifying the training process: perturbing inputsNing et al. (2023)，最小化累积误差作为正则化, minimizing cumulative errors as regularizationLi and van der Schaar (2024)，或者通过截断将模型暴露给它自己的错误, or exposing the model to its own errors via truncatedDeng et al. (2023)或分析模拟推出or analytically simulated rolloutsRen et al. (2024)。 其他方法通过修改训练目标、添加校正模块或在推理时重新调整预测来减轻扩散暴露偏差. Other methods mitigate diffusion exposure bias by modifying training objectives, adding correction modules, or rescaling predictions at inference timeRen et al. (2024); Zhang et al. (2025); Ning et al. (2024)。尽管上面引用的特定于扩散的方法主要解决视觉生成中的暴露偏差，但我们研究了它对解码的全局约束离散任务的影响。. Whereas the diffusion-specific approaches cited above address exposure bias primarily in visual generation, we study its effect on decoded globally constrained discrete tasks.

用于受限任务的非扩散求解器。Non-diffusion solvers for constrained tasks.

光网络OptNetAmos and Kolter (2017)和卫星网and SATNetWang et al. (2019)提出基于可微优化的求解器层。最近的工作探索了推理任务的递归细化模型present differentiable optimization-based solver layers. More recent work explores recursive refinement models for reasoning tasksWang et al. (2025); Jolicoeur-Martineau (2025)。此类模型通过在其细化的推出过程中进行训练来减轻错误复合。 我们的工作是互补的：我们的目的不是与这些求解器竞争，而是要描述这种设置中基于连续扩散的推理的基本限制。. Such models mitigate error compounding by training over rollouts of their refinement. Our work is complementary: we do not aim to compete with these solvers, but to characterize a fundamental limitation of continuous diffusion-based inference in such settings.

7 局限性Limitations

我们的实验侧重于受约束的离散任务。大多数任务使用带有 argmax 解码的 one-hot 编码，其中有效性是象征性的。 MNIST-数独、模拟位和随机嵌入实验表明，相同的机制出现在精确的独热向量之外，但评估仍然是符号数独有效性。因此，我们并不认为 Tweedie 重投影适用于感知丰富的领域，在这些领域的成功还需要对纹理、几何、颜色和精细细节上的多样化连续分布进行建模。Our experiments focus on constrained discrete tasks. Most tasks use one-hot encodings with argmax decoding, where validity is symbolic. MNIST-Sudoku, analog-bit and random-embedding experiments show that the same mechanism appears beyond exact one-hot vectors, but the evaluation is still symbolic Sudoku validity. We therefore do not claim that Tweedie reprojection is appropriate for perceptually rich domains, where success also requires modeling a diverse continuous distribution over texture, geometry, color, and fine details.

Tweedie 重投影改变了逆过程的性质。它使用Tweedie reprojection changes the nature of the reverse process. It usesxtx_{t}形成提案to form the proposalx^0=fθ​(xt,t)\hat{x}_{0}=f_{\theta}(x_{t},t)，但随后丢弃残差, but then discards the residualxt−α⁡(t)​x^0x_{t}-\alpha(t)\hat{x}_{0}，因此它不再强制噪声状态之间具有与 DDPM 后验更新相同的接近度。当状态包含错误的符号承诺时，这会有所帮助，但是在解码模式中存在有意义的变化的领域中，或者在精细的连续细节没有被完全捕获的领域中，这会有所帮助。, so it no longer enforces the same proximity between noisy states as DDPM posterior updates. This can help when the state contains wrong symbolic commitments, but in domains where meaningful variation exists within a decoded mode, or where fine continuous details are not fully captured byx^0\hat{x}_{0}，重复重投影可能会丢失状态保留采样器将保留的信息。, repeated reprojection may lose information that a state-preserving sampler would retain.

最后，自我修正只能部分解决训练与推理不匹配的问题。它将模型暴露于一步模型引发的状态，提高了训练覆盖率，但较长的采样轨迹仍然可以访问训练期间未得到很好表示的状态。更完整的解决方案可能需要新的训练目标或噪声过程，以更好地涵盖前向噪声数据和采样器引起的状态，我们将其留待将来的工作。Finally, self-correction only partially addresses the training-inference mismatch. It exposes the model to one-step model-induced states, improving training coverage, but longer sampling trajectories can still visit states not well represented during training. A more complete solution may require new training objectives or noise processes that better cover both forward-noised data and the sampler-induced states, which we leave for future work.

8 结论Conclusion

我们研究了代表约束离散任务的连续扩散模型 在连续的空间中。跨越数独， 图连通性、拉丁方、 和We studied continuous diffusion models for constrained discrete tasks represented in continuous space. Across Sudoku, graph connectivity, Latin squares, andNN-queens，相同的训练有素的降噪器在以下情况下的表现可能会非常不同 不同的逆过程。这揭示了训练与推理的不匹配： 对前向噪声有效对象进行标准去噪训练，而推理 采样可以创建局部合理但全局无效的状态 培训分布很好地涵盖了。 Tweedie 重投影通过删除直接的-queens, the same trained denoiser can behave very differently under different reverse processes. This reveals a training-inference mismatch: standard denoising trains on forward-noised valid objects, while inference sampling can create locally plausible but globally invalid states that are not well covered by the training distribution. Tweedie reprojection exposes this mismatch from the inference side by removing the directxtx_{t}来自反向更新的依赖残差。有效性的提高表明降噪器的干净建议包含有用的全局结构 标准轨迹可能无法利用。自我修正解决了 通过将模型暴露给它自己的中间体来从训练方面解决同样的问题 预测和训练恢复到原来的有效目标。-dependent residual from the reverse update. Improved validity indicates that the denoiser’s clean proposals contain useful global structure that the standard trajectory may fail to exploit. Self-correction addresses the same problem from the training side by exposing the model to its own intermediate predictions and training recovery to the original valid target.

总的来说，我们的结果表明连续扩散模型可以学习全局 约束，但受约束的离散推理需要更好地协调 用于训练的状态和采样过程中产生的状态。Overall, our results suggest that continuous diffusion models can learn global constraints, but constrained discrete reasoning requires better alignment between the states used for training and the states produced during sampling.

自校正训练的计算开销。Computational overhead of self-correction training.

标准去噪训练执行一次梯度前向传播和一次 每个优化器步骤向后传递。自我纠正训练增加了 (i) 一项 额外的Standard denoising training performs one gradient forward pass and one backward pass per optimizer step. Self-correction training adds (i) one additional无梯度gradient-free前向传递，生成模型 对第二个时间点重新加噪的预测，以及 (ii) 一个梯度 前向传递子批次forward pass, which produces the model prediction that is re-noised to the second time point, and (ii) one gradient forward pass on a sub-batch of⌊λsimple​B⌋\lfloor\lambda_{\mathrm{simple}}B\rfloor样品samples forℒsimple\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{simple}};进行一次向后传递 综合目标。将向后传递视为成本的两倍 前向传递，这预测了每步的训练成本; a single backward pass is taken on the combined objective. Counting a backward pass as twice the cost of a forward pass, this predicts a per-step training cost of(4+3λsimple)/3≈1.43×(4+3\lambda_{\mathrm{simple}})/3\approx 1.43\times的基线the baseline forλsimple=0.1\lambda_{\mathrm{simple}}=0.1。两种变体都经过训练 相同数量的优化器步骤（. Both variants are trained for the same number of optimizer steps (2×1062\times 10^{6}），推理成本为 不变，因为自我修正仅修改训练目标而不修改 采样器。), and inference cost is unchanged, as self-correction modifies only the training objective and not the sampler.

F.2 实验计算资源Experiments compute resources

训练是在具有 24 GiB VRAM 的单个 RTX 3090 上由一名工作人员完成的。 每次训练运行数独任务大约花费 17 小时，GC 任务花费 44 小时，拉丁任务花费 14 小时，N-皇后任务花费 10 小时。Training was done on a single RTX 3090 with 24 GiB of VRAM with a single worker. Each training run took approximately 17 hours on a Sudoku task, 44 hours on a GC task, 14 hours on a Latin task, 10 hours on a N-Queens task.

所有采样器和制度的每个检查点的标准纸质评估在大约 5-15 分钟内完成。图连通性的交叉验证实验计算量更大，通常需要大约 12-25 分钟才能使用 EM 和 EM 衰减采样器进行 5 倍评估。最昂贵的设置是 Sudoku Extreme pass@10 评估，由于样本数量和去噪步骤较多，每个采样器可能需要大约 30-50 分钟。Standard paper evaluations complete within approximately 5–15 minutes per checkpoint across all samplers and regimes. Cross-validation experiments for graph connectivity are more computationally intensive, usually requiring around 12–25 minutes for 5-fold evaluation with EM and EM decay samplers. The most expensive setting is Sudoku Extreme pass@10 evaluation, which can take approximately 30–50 minutes per sampler due to the large number of samples and denoising steps.

附录KAppendix KDDPM-Tweedie 采样器间隙的机理分析Mechanistic Analysis of DDPM-Tweedie Sampler Gap

本附录给出了 DDPM-Tweedie 间隙的机械解释。解码的有效性取决于单元格 argmax 决策：当采样器中心相对于噪声尺度具有足够的余量时，高斯扰动会保留解码状态。我们使用这个边缘视图来比较 Tweedie 重投影和 DDPM 祖先采样的中心。 Tweedie 围绕降噪器的预测重新定位下一个状态，而 DDPM 还保留当前噪声状态的残差分量。我们证明，这种残差对于离散约束问题是有害的。This appendix gives a mechanistic explanation of the DDPM-Tweedie gap. Decoded validity depends on cellwise argmax decisions: Gaussian perturbations preserve a decoded state when the sampler center has sufficient margin relative to the noise scale. We use this margin view to compare the centers of Tweedie reprojection and DDPM ancestral sampling. Tweedie recenters the next state around the denoiser’s prediction, while DDPM also retains a residual component from the current noisy state. We show that this residual turns out to be harmful for discrete constrained problems.

人物Figures7-8显示采样期间发生的情况。沿着 Tweedie 轨迹，模型在逆向过程结束之前开始预测有效的数独网格。重要的一点是，Tweedie 不会将下一个中心锚定到当前解码的网格。 相反，它直接居中于show what happens during sampling. Along the Tweedie trajectory, the model begins to predict valid Sudoku grids before the end of the reverse process. The important point is that Tweedie does not anchor the next center to the current decoded grid. Instead, it recenters directly atctTw=α⁡(t−1)​x^0,t.c_{t}^{\mathrm{Tw}}=\alpha({t-1})\hat{x}_{0,t}.由于乘以正标量Since multiplication by the positive scalarα⁡(t−1)\alpha({t-1})不改变argmax，Tweedie中心具有与模型预测相同的解码网格。 因此，如果当前样本接近有效但有一些错误的单元格，并且降噪器预测有效的完成，Tweedie 可以直接移动到有效的单元格 完成。does not change the argmax, the Tweedie center has the same decoded grid as the model prediction. Therefore, if the current sample is near-valid but has a few wrong cells, and the denoiser predicts a valid completion, Tweedie can move directly to that valid completion.

DDPM 的行为有所不同。它的中心还包含残差项DDPM behaves differently. Its center also contains the residual termBt​rtB_{t}r_{t}, 它保留了当前状态的一部分。当当前状态为 已经正确了，但是当当前状态接近有效时，它可能是有害的 很少有持续性的错误。在这种情况下，DDPM 更新对降噪器进行平均 修正当前错误的细胞偏好，因此采样器可以减少 约束违规次数，但仍无法进行最终 argmax 更改 需要完全有效。, which keeps part of the current state. This can be helpful when the current state is already correct, but it can be harmful when the current state is near-valid with a few persistent mistakes. In that case, the DDPM update averages the denoiser correction with the current wrong cell preferences, so the sampler can reduce the number of constraint violations while still failing to make the final argmax changes needed for full validity.

这解释了曝光间隙。在标准训练下，模型接受以下训练： 有效网格的噪声版本，因此某些无效区域很少接受训练 质量。然而，在采样过程中，模型自身的预测可能会改变轨迹 朝向无效或接近有效状态的嘈杂版本。自我纠错训练 因此，精确地增加了对这些采样器引起的输入的监督。This explains the exposure gap. Under standard training, the model is trained on noisy versions of valid grids, so certain invalid regions receive little training mass. During sampling, however, the model’s own predictions can move trajectories toward noisy versions of invalid or near-valid states. Self-correction training therefore adds supervision on precisely these sampler-induced inputs.

K.6 作为训练推理失配校正的自我校正Self-correction as train-inference mismatch correction

上一节认为 DDPM 可以进入模型诱导的状态，在该状态下 基线降噪器不再可靠地提出有效的网格。自我修正 通过改变监督输入分布来解决这种不匹配问题。相反 仅在前向噪声有效网格上进行训练，它也在噪声版本上进行训练 模型自己的中间预测，同时保持原始有效 网格作为回归目标。The previous section argued that DDPM can enter model-induced states on which the baseline denoiser no longer proposes valid grids reliably. Self-correction addresses this mismatch by changing the supervised input distribution. Instead of training only on forward-noised valid grids, it also trains on noisy versions of the model’s own intermediate predictions, while keeping the original valid grid as the regression target.

标准训练在前向噪声有效网格上学习贝叶斯降噪器。自我修正增加了围绕模型引发的预测的训练量Standard training learns the Bayes denoiser on forward-noised valid grids. Self-correction adds training mass around model-induced predictionsx~0\tilde{x}_{0}，这可能是无效的或部分错误的，并将模型训练为 将这些预测的噪声版本映射回原始有效网格。因此，自我校正的目标是闭环采样器（例如 DDPM）遇到的曝光间隙。, which may be invalid or partially wrong, and trains the model to map noisy versions of those predictions back to the original valid grid. Thus self-correction targets the exposure gap encountered by closed-loop samplers such as DDPM.

图Figure10比较了在数独谜题上构建恢复信号的替代方法与 21 条线索。输入扰动对基线几乎没有改善，这表明通用高斯噪声不会重现闭环采样产生的结构化误差。自调节也较弱，特别是对于DDPM，这表明仅仅提供额外的内存通道是不够的。最强大的变体是那些通过简单的自我校正损失或 DDPM 感知变体将模型暴露给其自己的中间预测的变体。这支持了我们的主要解释：问题不仅在于对噪声的鲁棒性或缺乏调节，而且在于前向噪声训练输入与采样期间访问的模型引起的状态之间的不匹配。compares alternative ways of constructing the recovery signal on Sudoku puzzles with 21 clues. Input perturbation gives little improvement over the baseline, suggesting that generic Gaussian noise does not reproduce the structured errors created by closed-loop sampling. Self-conditioning is also weaker, especially for DDPM, indicating that simply providing an additional memory channel is not enough. The strongest variants are those that expose the model to its own intermediate predictions, either through the simple self-correction loss or DDPM-aware variants. This supports our main interpretation: the issue is not only robustness to noise or lack of conditioning, but a mismatch between the forward-noised training inputs and the model-induced states visited during sampling.

Both configurations recover139139的of the297297解决方案，或solutions, or46.8%46.8\%。因此，针对单个干净目标的训练并不将采样限制为每组线索的单个完成。然而，这两种配置都无法恢复所有可能的完成，并且自校正不会提高本实验中的聚合覆盖率。. Thus, training against individual clean targets does not restrict sampling to a single completion for each set of clues. However, neither configuration recovers all possible completions, and self-correction does not improve the aggregate coverage in this experiment.

解码的预测何时停止变化？When do decoded predictions stop changing?

我们定义承诺时间We define the commitment timeτ⋆\tau^{\star}作为最早记录的反向进度值，之后解码的预测保持等于其最终解码的输出，其中as the earliest recorded reverse-progress value after which the decoded prediction remains equal to its final decoded output, withτ=0\tau=0在噪声和at noise andτ=1\tau=1在数据。在表的汇总结果中at data. In the pooled results of Table16，最终有效预测比最终无效预测更早稳定。自我修正与两组的后期稳定相关：对于最终无效的轨迹，平均承诺时间从, final-valid predictions stabilize earlier than final-invalid ones. Self-correction is associated with later stabilization in both groups: for final-invalid trajectories, the mean commitment time increases from0.920.92 to 0.980.98根据 DDPM 和under DDPM and from0.890.89 to 0.990.99在特威迪的领导下。这与自我修正相一致，允许模型更长时间地修改其预测，尽管这些修改不一定会产生有效的解决方案。under Tweedie. This is consistent with self-correction allowing the model to revise its predictions for longer, although these revisions do not necessarily lead to a valid solution.

Tweedie 重投影何时失败？When does Tweedie reprojection fail?

我们根据采样期间是否出现有效的干净提案来区分失败。当最终的 Tweedie 输出无效并且解码的干净提案在任何记录的反向步骤中从未有效时，失败与降噪器相关。在诊断批次中We distinguish failures according to whether a valid clean proposal appears during sampling. A failure is denoiser-related when the final Tweedie output is invalid and the decoded clean proposal was never valid at any recorded reverse step. In a diagnostic batch of256256无条件的unconditionalNN-皇后轨迹，所有失败都是这种类型。在极限数独中，-Queens trajectories, all failures are of this type. On Sudoku-Extreme,38%38\%的 Tweedie 故障与降噪器相关。在剩余的of Tweedie failures are denoiser-related. In the remaining62%62\%，有效的提案至少出现一次，但轨迹仍然以无效样本结束。因此，较差的提案质量是 Tweedie 重投影的限制之一，但在采样期间找到有效的提案本身并不能保证有效的最终输出。, a valid proposal appears at least once, but the trajectory still ends in an invalid sample. Poor proposal quality is therefore one limitation of Tweedie reprojection, but finding a valid proposal during sampling does not by itself guarantee a valid final output.
